howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps to secure, verified commodity trading

step1.title: Register & Verify
step1.description: Create your company profile and complete KYC/KYB verification to access the platform.

step2.title: Submit Request
step2.description: Post a buy request or supply offer with full specifications, quantity, and delivery terms.

step3.title: Match & Negotiate
step3.description: Our brokers match compatible parties in private deal rooms with document sharing and video meetings.

step4.title: Agree & Trade
step4.description: Sign agreements, finalize terms, and proceed to settlement through your banking channels.
